10: - Use its headed Chromium, persistent Xvfb display, and SwiftShader configuration.
11: - Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` for the Pascal development server.
12: - Load a saved scene. Wait for actual geometry and the active WebGPU renderer.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Build a complete, playable mobile/tablet-friendly 3D game combining Slay the Spire-style deckbuilding with Pokémon-style creature catching.

## Requirements
- Build now without clarification; make reasonable assumptions.
- Support phone and tablet play with usable touch controls.
- Save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px) for checks and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Created “Mythbound — Wilds of Aether,” a responsive single-page deckbuilding roguelike.
- Used a custom animated canvas forest arena with 3D-inspired perspective and creature glyphs, avoiding external game-engine dependencies.
- Implemented cards, turn-based combat, capture orbs, rewards, route choices, deck viewing, help, and an eight-floor expedition.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created responsive game UI, battle scene, and gameplay systems.
- Added capture chance based on enemy health, creature rewards, combat log, and mobile end-turn controls.
- Verified `node --check game.js`, `git diff --check`, HTTP 200, desktop/mobile screenshots, and a card-play interaction in browser.
- Added `favicon.svg`.

### Active
- No active changes; latest addition was Briarback as an additional wild encounter.

### Blocked
- Browser check reported a missing-browser error initially; opening with `playwright-cli open --browser chrome` succeeded using the installed Chrome channel.
- No current blockers.

## Next Move
1. Optionally rerun `node --check game.js` and browser smoke checks after the latest enemy roster edit.
2. Finish with a concise summary of implemented features and note that browser gameplay was smoke-tested; changes remain uncommitted.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Game page structure and HUD.
- `style.css`: Responsive desktop/mobile layout and visual styling.
- `game.js`: Combat, cards, catching, rewards, progression, and canvas scene.
- `favicon.svg`: Project icon.

## Important Context
- User’s exact game brief: `"2D Slay the Spire deckbuilding with Pokémon catching (3D Game, Phone/Tablet)"`.
- Local smoke-test server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`; browser URL was `http://localhost:3002`.
- `node --check game.js` and `git diff --check` passed before the last enemy roster edit.
- Changes are uncommitted.
